newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sentenced on insider trading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sentenced on insider trading.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said corporate relations consultant Murray Williams was sentenced on Friday to 18 months periodic detention and fined A$50,000.
The corporate watchdog said this is the first insider trading case successfully prosecuted by the ASC.
It said a court had found Williams purchased shares in pay television operator Australis Media Ltd while in the possession of information which was not generally available.
Williams was a corporate relations consultant retained by Australis when he purchased 200,000 Australis shares in November 1993.
